name: rtmo-posture-bundle
notes: RTMO (bottom-up whole-frame pose estimator, mmpose/mmdeploy export). Finds every person and their pose directly on the full frame, no tiling and no person-detector crop, so this runs as pipeline 'raw'. The engine's own graph does its NMS (TensorRT parses the exporter's NonMaxSuppression node as a native internal NMS layer — no plugin, no graph surgery); the RTMOHandler in vendor/onnx_infer/arch/rtmo.py then turns each person's 17 COCO keypoints into a standing/sitting/lying label, which is what actually reaches Detection.boxes as class_name. Batch is structurally 1 (engine built with a static [1,3,640,640] profile, matching how every other whole-frame bundle here runs one image per forward pass).
